description: On the table in front are two clear plastic food containers with snap lids: a smaller one with a pink item and a larger one with a yellow piece inside. The left hand steadies the small container while the right hand brings its lid over and presses it down to close it, then both hands shift to the larger container, lift and open its lid, and the right hand reaches into the open container to touch or remove the yellow piece while the left hand holds the container in place.
